name: Breast Cancer
description: Malignant neoplasm arising from mammary epithelial ductal or lobular tissue, strongly influenced by BRCA1, BRCA2, HER2, and ESR1 alterations.
associated_genes: BRCA1, BRCA2, ERBB2, ESR1, PIK3CA, PALB2, TP53
primary_manifestations: Mammary mass, axillary lymphadenopathy, skin retraction, nipple discharge

name: Alzheimer Disease
description: Progressive neurodegenerative cortical disorder marked by extracellular amyloid-beta plaques, intracellular tau neurofibrillary tangles, and severe synaptic loss.
associated_genes: APOE, MAPT, APP, TREM2, PSEN1, PSEN2
primary_manifestations: Progressive memory impairment, spatial disorientation, executive dysfunction, aphasia

name: Type 2 Diabetes
description: Chronic endocrine disorder characterized by skeletal muscle and hepatic insulin resistance alongside progressive pancreatic beta-cell secretory failure.
associated_genes: INS, TNF, IL6, PPARG, TCF7L2, KCNJ11
primary_manifestations: Hyperglycemia, polyuria, polydipsia, fatigue, microvascular retinoneuropathy

name: Colorectal Cancer
description: Malignant transformation of glandular epithelial mucosa in the colon or rectum, frequently initiated by APC or Wnt pathway mutations.
associated_genes: APC, CTNNB1, KRAS, TP53, MLH1, MSH2, BRAF
primary_manifestations: Rectal bleeding, iron deficiency anemia, altered bowel habits, abdominal cramping

name: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
description: Heterogeneous group of epithelial lung malignancies including adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma, driven by EGFR, KRAS, or ALK mutations.
associated_genes: EGFR, KRAS, ALK, BRAF, MET, TP53, CD274
primary_manifestations: Persistent cough, hemoptysis, dyspnea, pleural effusion, weight loss

name: Glioblastoma
description: Highly aggressive grade IV astrocytic intracranial tumor characterized by diffuse microvascular proliferation and extensive pseudopalisading necrosis.
associated_genes: PTEN, EGFR, TP53, IDH1, MGMT, PDGFRA
primary_manifestations: New-onset seizures, persistent headaches, localized focal neurological deficits

name: Parkinson Disease
description: Movement disorder characterized by degeneration of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra pars compacta and alpha-synuclein-containing Lewy bodies.
associated_genes: SNCA, PRKN, PINK1, LRRK2, GBA
primary_manifestations: Rest tremor, cogwheel rigidity, bradykinesia, postural instability

name: Atherosclerosis
description: Chronic inflammatory fibro-fatty lesion development in large and medium arterial walls driven by oxidized LDL deposition and macrophage recruitment.
associated_genes: PCSK9, APOE, IL1B, LDLR, APOB, TNF
primary_manifestations: Angina pectoris, intermittent claudication, myocardial infarction, ischemic stroke

name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
description: Systemic autoimmune inflammatory disorder targeting synovial joints, leading to cartilage destruction, bony erosions, and systemic vascular inflammation.
associated_genes: TNF, IL6, HLA-DRB1, PTPN22, JAK2
primary_manifestations: Symmetric polyarthritis, morning joint stiffness, subcutaneous nodules, fatigue

name: Ovarian Cancer
description: Malignant neoplasm arising from epithelial surface or fimbrial fallopian tube cells, frequently presenting late with diffuse peritoneal dissemination.
associated_genes: BRCA1, BRCA2, TP53, RAD51, PALB2
primary_manifestations: Abdominal distension, persistent early satiety, pelvic pain, ascites

name: Cutaneous Melanoma
description: Malignant transformation of epidermal melanocytes associated with ultraviolet radiation exposure and BRAF V600 or NRAS driver mutations.
associated_genes: BRAF, NRAS, CDKN2A, TP53, KIT
primary_manifestations: Asymmetric pigmented skin lesion, irregular borders, color variation, diameter >6mm

name: Cystic Fibrosis
description: Autosomal recessive multisystem monogenic disorder caused by CFTR ion channel mutations, resulting in viscous inspissated mucus and chronic lung infections.
associated_genes: CFTR
primary_manifestations: Chronic suppurative cough, bronchiectasis, pancreatic exocrine insufficiency, meconium ileus

name: Renal Cell Carcinoma
description: Malignant neoplasm arising from renal proximal tubular epithelium, strongly linked to VHL tumor suppressor gene inactivation and VEGFA neoangiogenesis.
associated_genes: VHL, VEGFA, BAP1, SETD2, PBRM1, MET
primary_manifestations: Flank pain, painless gross hematuria, palpable abdominal mass, hypertension

name: Burkitt Lymphoma
description: Aggressive mature B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma characterized by high proliferation index and chromosomal translocations of MYC with immunoglobulin loci.
associated_genes: MYC, BCL2, TP53, ID3, CCND3
primary_manifestations: Rapidly enlarging jaw mass, abdominal organ infiltration, tumor lysis syndrome

name: Frontotemporal Dementia
description: Neurodegenerative clinical syndrome involving selective degeneration of frontal and temporal brain lobes, driven by tau or TDP-43 neuropathology.
associated_genes: MAPT, GRN, C9orf72, VCP, CHMP2B
primary_manifestations: Marked personality alterations, disinhibition, loss of empathy, progressive aphasia

name: Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
description: Lethal malignancy originating from pancreatic ductal cells, characterized by dense desmoplastic stroma and near-universal KRAS mutations.
associated_genes: KRAS, TP53, CDKN2A, SMAD4, BRCA2, PALB2
primary_manifestations: Painless jaundice, epigastric pain radiating to back, rapid weight loss, new-onset diabetes

name: Polycythemia Vera
description: Myeloproliferative neoplasm characterized by clonal erythrocytosis, increased granulocytes, and persistent activation of JAK2 kinase signaling.
associated_genes: JAK2, CALR, MPL, TET2, ASXL1
primary_manifestations: Aquagenic pruritus, splenomegaly, erythromelalgia, arterial and venous thrombosis

name: Endometrial Carcinoma
description: Malignant epithelial tumor of the uterine endometrium, classified molecularly into POLE-mutated, microsatellite-unstable, copy-number-low, and copy-number-high subtypes.
associated_genes: PTEN, PIK3CA, POLE, MLH1, MSH2, TP53
primary_manifestations: Abnormal postmenopausal uterine bleeding, lower abdominal pain, pelvic mass

name: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
description: Monoclonal expansion and tissue accumulation of mature, immunoincompetent B lymphocytes, heavily reliant on anti-apoptotic BCL2 overexpression.
associated_genes: BCL2, TP53, NOTCH1, SF3B1, ATM, MYD88
primary_manifestations: Painless lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly, recurrent opportunistic infections, fatigue

name: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
description: Clonal proliferation of poorly differentiated myeloid precursor blasts in bone marrow and peripheral blood, suppressing normal hematopoietic lineages.
associated_genes: NPM1, FLT3, DNMT3A, TP53, IDH1, IDH2
primary_manifestations: Severe anemia, granulocytopenic fever, bruising, bleeding petechiae, bone pain

name: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
description: Multisystem autoimmune disease characterized by loss of self-tolerance, antinuclear autoantibody production, and immune complex deposition in kidneys and skin.
associated_genes: TNF, IL6, STAT4, PTPN22, IRF5, TLR7
primary_manifestations: Malar rash, photosensitivity, glomerulonephritis, inflammatory arthritis, pleuritis

name: Dilated Cardiomyopathy
description: Myocardial disorder characterized by left ventricular enlargement and systolic contractile impairment in the absence of severe coronary artery stenosis.
associated_genes: TTN, LMNA, MYH7, TNNT2, BAG3, RBM20
primary_manifestations: Congestive dyspnea, orthopnea, lower extremity edema, ventricular arrhythmias

name: Ataxia-Telangiectasia
description: Autosomal recessive neurodegenerative and immunodeficiency syndrome caused by ATM kinase deficiency, presenting with cerebellar ataxia and ocular telangiectasias.
associated_genes: ATM
primary_manifestations: Progressive cerebellar ataxia, oculocutaneous telangiectasias, sinopulmonary infections

name: Lynch Syndrome
description: Hereditary cancer predisposition syndrome caused by germline mutations in mismatch repair genes, predisposing carriers to colorectal and endometrial cancers.
associated_genes: MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2, EPCAM
primary_manifestations: Early-onset right-sided colon cancer, synchronous and metachronous adenocarcinomas

name: Ischemic Heart Disease
description: Impaired myocardial perfusion and oxygen supply typically resulting from coronary atherosclerotic plaque rupture and thrombosis.
associated_genes: PCSK9, APOE, IL1B, LDLR, NOS3
primary_manifestations: Substernal chest pressure on exertion, dyspnea, diaphoresis, myocardial necrosis
